text:
flirting is easy until you have to flirt
with someone you actually want.

i don't give mixed signals.
you just have selective hearing and wishful thinking.

if i like you, i will reply in 2 seconds or 2 business days.
there is no in-between.

you're my favorite reason
to lose sleep and ignore everyone else.

texting me is high risk, high reward.
mostly high risk.

i'm not hard to get.
you just have to catch me between naps and existential dread.

my red flags are visible from outer space
yet here you are setting up camp.

accidentally opened your message immediately.
now i have to fake my own death.

i look at you the way
a hamster looks at the last sunflower seed.

i said i was over you
not that i have self-respect.

we could be toxic together
but you're playing games with amateur rules.

my love language is sending 47 reels
and expecting you to watch every single one.

i didn't catch feelings.
i slipped on your audacity and fell.

sorry for being late,
i was having an imaginary argument in my head.

looking respectfully.
(not respectfully at all)

it's 2:43 AM.
time to either change my entire identity
or eat cold leftovers in complete darkness.

my brain at 2 PM: *dial-up connection noise*
my brain at 2 AM: here is a 45-slide presentation on why you are doomed.

do you ever just sit there and think
'who gave me permission to be an adult?'

staring at the ceiling recalculating
every conversation i've had since 2018.

i am one mild inconvenience away
from moving into the forest and befriending crows.

my bed is a magical place where i suddenly
remember everything i forgot to do today.

the silence in my room is loud
but my intrusive thoughts are louder.

sleep is so nice because you're not dead
and you're not awake. it's the perfect middle ground.

i have 43 tabs open in my browser
and 792 open in my brain.

my sleep schedule isn't even a schedule anymore.
it's just a roulette wheel.

if overthinking burned calories
i would have vanished into thin air by now.

i don't have ducks in a row.
i have squirrels at a rave.

why fall in love when you can fall asleep
and avoid all emotional collateral damage.

i'm not a night owl or an early bird.
i'm some sort of exhausted pigeon.

everything happens for a reason.
sometimes that reason is you're stupid and make bad choices.

i'm not pessimistic.
i'm just an optimist with life experience.

my therapist told me to embrace my mistakes.
so i hugged myself.

i entered adulthood with zero tutorial
and the difficulty set on extreme nightmare.

life is like a wheel.
except someone greased it and threw it down a flight of stairs.

i'm not arguing.
i'm just explaining why i'm right and you should listen.

you can't make everyone happy.
you're not a taco or a sleeping pill.

i don't hold grudges.
i just remember facts with extreme emotional intensity.

money can't buy happiness
but it can buy a black coffee and peace of mind.

i am currently experiencing what historians
will refer to as 'the downfall'.

i've reached the point in life where my favorite party
is the one that gets canceled.

remember when you were a kid and wanted to be older?
what an absolute scam.

i'm not antisocial.
i'm selectively social. there's a difference.

my mood depends heavily on
whether someone spoke to me before my first meal.

social battery at 2%.
please do not make eye contact or ask how i am.

i replied in my head.
in my heart, we have concluded the conversation.

canceling plans gives me a dopamine hit
that modern science cannot explain.

i have two speeds:
1. completely overwhelmed
2. horizontal in bed doing nothing.
saying 'no worries' while actively drowning in worry.

i went outside once.
the graphics were okay but the plot and NPCs were terrible.

my favorite hobby is putting things in online shopping carts
and then closing the tab.

cleaning my room by moving clothes
from the chair to the bed and back to the chair.

he said he was emotionally unavailable.
i said 'say less, let me fix you'.

dating in 2026 is just two emotionally damaged people
asking each other 'so what's your trauma?'.

i don't need a relationship.
i need someone to pay half my rent and leave me alone.

saw your story within 0.4 seconds.
i'm not obsessed, i just have no life.

my ideal date: you talk, i nod,
we eat good food, and we leave before 9 PM.

never let someone waste your time twice.
there are 8 billion people, let someone new disappoint you.

i see your red flag and i raise you
my pathological desire to ignore it.
